conventions.business_attributes: snake_case of the SQL column name (SalesOrderID -> sales_order_id); one attribute per column unless omitted/transformed

meta_attributes.type: entity type name (every item) - zero-ETL/Redshift unpacks overloaded items by this
meta_attributes.ver: integer version, +1 on every write (optimistic concurrency via ConditionExpression)
meta_attributes.src: 'sql' (came from SQL via load/CDC) or 'ddb' (created natively by the .NET 10 app)
meta_attributes.src_table: source table, e.g. Sales.SalesOrderHeader (null for ddb-native items)
meta_attributes.src_pk: source primary key as "Col=val[,Col=val]" - CDC upsert/delete address
meta_attributes.src_lsn: last applied CDC LSN / commit position (hex string); "0x00000000000000000000" for bulk load (sorts below any real LSN). Format "0x" + 20 hex digits so string order = LSN order. CDC writes are conditional on src_lsn < new
meta_attributes.deleted: true on tombstones (SQL delete -> tombstone, decision D10); GSI attributes are removed so tombstones drop out of indexes
meta_attributes.ttl: epoch seconds; set on carts (7 days, D3) and later on tombstones

conventions.derived_items: items marked derived (lookup/uniqueness/sparse-marker items) are rebuilt from the same source row and tombstoned/deleted with it
conventions.numbers: decimals and money stored as DynamoDB Number (exact); datetimes as ISO-8601 strings; uniqueidentifier as string; xml as string unless transform xml_map

table_settings.encryption: customer-managed KMS key for aw-hr and aw-customer; AWS-managed key elsewhere
table_settings.native_order_id: one atomic ADD next_id 1 per order

native_items.purpose: D5: DynamoDB-native order ids = UpdateItem ADD next_id :1 (starts at 1,000,000,000 > SQL max 75,123); order number 'SO-DDB-<id>', src='ddb'

static_carry_over.note: decision 3: one-time static load from AdventureWorksDW2022

Production.Product.source_sql:
SELECT p.*, s.Name AS subcategory_name, s.ProductCategoryID AS category_id, c.Name AS category_name, m.Name AS model_name,
       (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(i.Quantity),0) FROM Production.ProductInventory i WHERE i.ProductID = p.ProductID) AS stock_qty,
       CASE WHEN p.SellEndDate IS NULL AND p.DiscontinuedDate IS NULL THEN 'A' ELSE 'X' END AS x_active,
       LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(p.Name))) AS x_name_lower
FROM Production.Product p LEFT JOIN Production.ProductSubcategory s ON s.ProductSubcategoryID = p.ProductSubcategoryID LEFT JOIN Production.ProductCategory c ON c.ProductCategoryID = s.ProductCategoryID LEFT JOIN Production.ProductModel m ON m.ProductModelID = p.ProductModelID

Sales.SalesOrderHeader.source_sql:
SELECT h.*, c.AccountNumber AS customer_account_number,
       COALESCE(p.FirstName + ' ' + p.LastName, s.Name) AS customer_name, s.Name AS store_name,
       sm.Name AS ship_method_name,
       sa.AddressLine1 AS ship_to_line1, sa.AddressLine2 AS ship_to_line2, sa.City AS ship_to_city, ssp.StateProvinceCode AS ship_to_state, sa.PostalCode AS ship_to_postal_code, ssp.CountryRegionCode AS ship_to_country,
       ba.AddressLine1 AS bill_to_line1, ba.AddressLine2 AS bill_to_line2, ba.City AS bill_to_city, bsp.StateProvinceCode AS bill_to_state, ba.PostalCode AS bill_to_postal_code, bsp.CountryRegionCode AS bill_to_country,
       cc.CardType AS card_type, RIGHT(cc.CardNumber, 4) AS card_last4,
       cr.FromCurrencyCode AS currency_from, cr.ToCurrencyCode AS currency_to, cr.AverageRate AS currency_average_rate
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader h JOIN Sales.Customer c ON c.CustomerID = h.CustomerID LEFT JOIN Person.Person p ON p.BusinessEntityID = c.PersonID LEFT JOIN Sales.Store s ON s.BusinessEntityID = c.StoreID JOIN Purchasing.ShipMethod sm ON sm.ShipMethodID = h.ShipMethodID JOIN Person.Address sa ON sa.AddressID = h.ShipToAddressID JOIN Person.StateProvince ssp ON ssp.StateProvinceID = sa.StateProvinceID JOIN Person.Address ba ON ba.AddressID = h.BillToAddressID JOIN Person.StateProvince bsp ON bsp.StateProvinceID = ba.StateProvinceID LEFT JOIN Sales.CreditCard cc ON cc.CreditCardID = h.CreditCardID LEFT JOIN Sales.CurrencyRate cr ON cr.CurrencyRateID = h.CurrencyRateID

Query GSI1 GSI1PK = 'SUBCAT#<sub:04d>' AND GSI1SK = '#META'  (subcategory by id)
PutItem/UpdateItem/DeleteItem (ConditionExpression attribute_exists(PK)); delete guarded by app check: Query GSI1 SUBCAT#<sub> begins_with PRODUCT# Limit 1

ops: TransactWriteItems: Put product (ConditionExpression attribute_not_exists(PK) for create / ver = :v for update) + Put PRODUCTNAMES/<name> (attribute_not_exists) + Put PRODUCTNUMBER#<n> (attribute_not_exists) [+ Delete old name/number items on rename] [+ Put PRICE#<date> history on price change]
Query PK = 'PRODUCT#<p:06d>' AND SK BETWEEN 'PRICE#' AND 'PRICE#<dateIso>', ScanIndexForward=false, Limit=1 (then check end_date)

ops: Query PK = 'PRODUCT#<p:06d>' AND SK <= 'PRODUCT'  (INV#<loc> items + PRODUCT copy with stock_qty)

ops: Query PK = 'PRODUCT#<p:06d>' AND SK BETWEEN 'TXN#<fromIso>' AND 'TXN#<toIso>~', ScanIndexForward=false
PutItem TXN#<iso>#<id> + UpdateItem ADD quantity on INV#<loc> (TransactWrite)
Query PK = 'ASSEMBLY#<a:06d>' (repeat per level for children; filter start_date <= d < end_date client-side)
access_patterns.compromise: multi-level explosion = one Query per assembly per level (max depth 4)

ops: Query GSI1 GSI1PK = 'COMPONENT#<c:06d>' (repeat upwards per level)
Query GSI2 GSI2PK = 'WODUE#<yyyy-mm>' AND GSI2SK BETWEEN '<fromIso>' AND '<toIso>~' (one query per month in range)
access_patterns.compromise: date range spanning months = one Query per month bucket; 'open' is a filter (all historical WOs are closed)

ops: UpdateItem PK='COUNTER', SK='ORDER' ADD next_id :1 ReturnValues=UPDATED_NEW -> id >= 1,000,000,000 (D5)
TransactWriteItems: Put ORDER (attribute_not_exists(PK)) + Put LINE#n ... + Delete CART items (<= 100 actions)
access_patterns.compromise: orders with > ~95 lines + cart rows exceed the 100-action transaction limit -> split cart cleanup out of the transaction

ops: Query GSI1 GSI1PK = 'CUSTOMER#<c:06d>' AND begins_with(GSI1SK, 'ORDER#'), ScanIndexForward=false

Query GSI1 GSI1PK = 'CUSTOMER#<storeCustomerId:06d>' AND GSI1SK BETWEEN 'ORDER#<fromIso>' AND 'ORDER#<toIso>~'

TransactWriteItems Put PO + LINE#n items (+ POSTATUS# marker)
Query GSI1 GSI1PK = 'VENDOR#<v:06d>' AND begins_with(GSI1SK, 'PO#'), ScanIndexForward=false [FilterExpression status = :s]
Query GSI2 GSI2PK = 'EMPLOYEE#<e:06d>' AND begins_with(GSI2SK, 'PO#'), ScanIndexForward=false

Query PK = 'EMPLOYEE#<e:06d>' AND begins_with(SK, 'DEPT#') / begins_with(SK, 'PAY#'), ScanIndexForward=false
Query GSI2 GSI2PK = 'ORG' AND begins_with(GSI2SK, '<manager org_path>')  (whole subtree)
chain: Query GSI2 GSI2PK = 'ORG' AND GSI2SK = '<ancestor path>' per level
UpdateItem PK='EMPLOYEE#<e>', SK='EMPLOYEE' SET ... ConditionExpression ver = :v
Query PK = 'FX#<from>#<to>' AND SK <= '<dateIso>~', ScanIndexForward=false, Limit=1
for each item of mapping.items_for_row(after-image): PutItem ConditionExpression attribute_not_exists(PK) OR src_lsn < :lsn

for each item of mapping.items_for_row(before-image): PutItem tombstone {PK, SK, type, deleted=true, deleted_at, src_*} ConditionExpression attribute_not_exists(PK) OR src_lsn < :lsn (GSI keys dropped)

e.g. Address change: Query aw-customer GSI1 GSI1PK = 'ADDRESS#<id>' -> UpdateItem each PartyAddress copy (+ aw-purchasing VendorAddress); ProductDescription: Query aw-catalog GSI1 'DESCRIPTION#<id>'; SpecialOffer: Query GSI1 'OFFER#<id>'
every item key template references only columns of its own source row -> child items are written without reading the parent
